notes.title: Illustrations of some characters were changed!
notes.content:
Some character illustrations have been changed to the latest version!

The quest function will take a little longer as we are still working on the event content and its reflection.

Thank you for your continued support of Haderia Quest and Annulus.

notes.title: Notice of Planned Implementation of Quest Function
notes.content:
Good morning. This is Annulus.

We are pleased to report that the implementation of the quest function, which has been planned for some time, is almost complete, although it has taken some time.
The function is almost completed, so the official implementation will be done after the events using the function are implemented.

Thank you for your continued support of Annulus and Harderia Quest.

notes.title: WASD movement is now supported!
notes.content:
WASD movement is now supported!
From now on, you can play with a keyboard without a crosshair or with the keys you are used to in FPS/TPS!

notes.title: Some bugs were fixed!
notes.content:
Long time ago. This is Annulus.

We have fixed some bugs related to obtaining items such as treasure chests!

Thank you for your continued support of Harderia Quest.

notes.title: Some content has been added!
notes.content:
The following contents have been implemented!

Some new maps have been added.
Added some new elements
Fixed some bugs.

Thank you for your continued support of Harderia Quest and Doujin Circle Annulus.

notes.title: Correction of character dialogue, etc.
notes.content:
Hello. This is Annulus.

We have corrected the dialogue of some characters present in the story!

Thank you for your continued support of Harderia Quest and the doujinshi circle Annulus.

notes.title: Expansion of various functions & bug fixes
notes.content:
The following items have been implemented!

Fixed minor bugs
Added a function to return to the title.
Addition of logs
Improved the sound of the title screen and added options.

In addition, we have changed the composition of store items and expanded internal elements such as the addition of treasure chests.

We look forward to your continued support of Harderia Quest and Doujin Circle Annulus.
